shared_elements: carved/incised design occupying a framed panel on an upright stone slab
enclosing border or frame around the central design
stylized non-figural or emblematic motifs within the frame
justification: Both show a design set inside a framing border on a standing slab, but that is a generic convention; A depicts a single large schematic outline motif (a boat-like or hat-like form with a mast and a row of wave/arch shapes below), while B shows dense columns of small rounded pictorial glyph blocks in a grid plus a seated human figure with hat and staff. The manner of depiction differs entirely: sparse thin outline drawing versus modelled, packed relief units, so no shared specific iconography is evident.
